row.team_price_text: Family: $12/mo flat for 2 to 6 Plus accounts (billed yearly); Team: $50/mo flat for up to 10 accounts
row.evidence: Craft's help centre says it supports three authentication methods (email one-time code, Apple ID, Google sign-in), and neither the pricing page nor the help centre mentions SAML SSO or SCIM; team members are invited manually.
row.notes: Flat-priced bundles, so per-user fields stay null: Plus $6.4/mo yearly (single user), Family $12/mo yearly for 2 to 6 Plus accounts (the help centre calls it Team 6), Team $50/mo yearly for up to 10 Plus accounts; more than 10 seats is contact-us. Sign-in is email code, Apple ID or Google only (social sign-in, not SSO). Team roles are Owner and Member; members are invited and removed by hand. The Craft API and MCP access are document/content APIs created per connection, not user management. The help centre's own price list (Plus $96/yr or $10/mo, Family $180/yr or $18/mo, Team $600/yr or $60/mo) differs from the pricing page for Plus and Family; pricing-page figures are used. No Okta OIN app found.

limitations.text: The Craft API exposes documents, daily notes and tasks through per-connection endpoints; no user or team-member management is documented.

fallbacks.notes: Members must be invited to the Team before they can be added to Spaces; Owners remove members.
